name: agent-mail-monitor
description: Wake a durable Codex thread when non-consuming Agent Mail delivery is observed; operate the production ingress supervisor.

interface.shortDescription: Wake Codex when Agent Mail arrives.
interface.longDescription: Read-only mailbox watching plus a production control surface (doctor/start/stop/inspect/handoff) for the durable Agent Mail Codex ingress. Never consumes inbox state; never silently changes identity, thread, or install scope.
defaultPrompt: Doctor my production Agent Mail Codex binding.
Diagnose my Agent Mail monitor setup.
